title: Join us for the July 23rd, 2026 KPN Webinar!
bodyHtml:
? Rare-variant association studies: a primer, a problem, and a proposal for baseline masks
? Thursday, July 23rd, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET
?️ Featured speaker: Trang Nguyen, The Broad Institute

What topics will we cover in this forum:

  • A brief primer on rare-variant association studies (RVAS)
  • A widespread problem regarding "masks" in RVAS
  • A proposal for baseline masks to increase consistency and replicability in future studies

? Explore Trang's paper before the talk: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-026-02597-9
? Register for the event: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN__dgDoIUZSVyPwKvZ3Xx7mQ
summary: Trang Nguyen will present on "Rare-variant association studies: a primer, a problem, and a proposal for baseline masks."
